title: Add a CSV export for the orders report
description: Backs the finance team's report download with a service that writes orders to a CSV file and a helper that tallies counts by status for the header.

expected.note: The file returned by `open(...)` is never closed (no `with` block and no `handle.close()`), so every export leaks a file descriptor until GC runs and can exhaust the process's handles. Use a `with open(...) as handle:` block.

The default `totals={}` is evaluated once at definition time and shared across every call, so counts accumulate between exports instead of starting empty. Default to `None` and create a fresh dict inside the function.
